name: EPIC 220544324

text.card: A red giant 2,778 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.89 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,646 K at its surface.
